equity_curve_method: For each sell date, equal-weight the net returns of trades exiting that date; compound daily exit-date returns from initial equity 1.0.

rule_audit.entry: T signal; ma5_distance in [0.03,0.10] and pressure_distance in [0.30,0.50]
rule_audit.t_plus_1_buy: T+1 open <= T MA5 * 1.03; execution price is T+1 open
rule_audit.earliest_exit: T+2; no same-day exit on T+1
rule_audit.extreme_stop_execution: If T+2 low <= buy price * 0.95, sell price is buy price * 0.95
rule_audit.20_day_high_source: Input dataset field built from prior 20 trading records
